== Course of events ==

Having secured the aid of the Winged Monkeys through the charm of the Golden Cap, Dorothy set out with the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and the Cowardly Lion to make their own way back toward the Emerald City. Their path led them through wide fields of buttercups and daisies, and amid the sea of yellow and white blossoms the four companions lost their way, unable to find the road that would take them back to the Emerald City.

The disorientation among the flowers left Dorothy, the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and the Cowardly Lion without a clear course forward, stranded in the fields rather than progressing toward their destination. It was in the aftermath of this setback that the Winged Monkeys arrived to carry the travelers onward, the Monkey King explaining as they flew why his people were bound to obey the bearer of the Golden Cap, a story reaching back to Gayelette and Quelala.
